definition: potentially_cut_off = disconnected in the simplified road graph after removing flood-affected edges: the settlement's nearest road node is in the main road network (largest component by length) before removing blocked edges and not in it after. Graph indicator only; not confirmed real-world isolation.
limitations: footpaths (path/footway/steps/...) are excluded from the graph
graph clipped to the AOI: roads continuing beyond it (e.g. NH42 south of Bhainse) are invisible, so alternative access outside the AOI is not considered
depends on the unvalidated model flood prediction
blocked_edge_rule: edge length inside flood >= 10.0 m (prototype rule, not calibrated)
